name: Gem
summary: Gem quotes its two plans by company headcount: one that sits on top of an existing applicant tracking system and one with a built-in ATS. The only listed price is $130 a month, billed yearly, for startups with 1 to 10 employees.

facts.text: Gem's Talent Communities are meant for roles a company hires repeatedly or finds hard to fill, and they keep those candidates warm until a new requisition opens.
Nurture campaigns target candidates who are not ready to move yet, and the tool drafts outreach that can refer to a past interview or a previous rejection.
The sourcing extension adds profiles from LinkedIn and over 20 other sites in one click, and Gem says it syncs with Greenhouse, Workday, Lever, iCIMS and SuccessFactors.
Companies under 30 employees get Gem All-in-One free for six months, then 50% off on a paid plan.

plans.name: Startup Program (1 to 10 employees)
plans.notes: Shown with 10% off against a struck-through $270. Includes AI sourcing and CRM, analytics, scheduling and ATS.

hiddenCosts: Startups with 30 to 100 employees get reduced rates from day one, but the page lists no figures.
The page shows no per-seat prices and no monthly billing option for the Startup Program.
